question: Who currently owns billing-api?
sentence: Luca Ostrander currently owns billing-api, having taken ownership on 2026‑09‑22 15:28 UTC.

sources.title: ADR-0009: Transfer billing-api ownership from Sana Petrov to Luca Ostrander
sources.author: Selma Marsh

queries: MATCH (n:System) WHERE n.name = $n RETURN 'System' AS label, n.name AS name

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:OWNS]->(s:System {name: $system}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH prov = (s)<-[:ABOUT]-(g:GateDecision)-[:CITES]->(e:Episode) WHERE g.predicate = 'OWNS' AND g.subject = p.name AND g.outcome IN $ok AND e.id IN r.source_ids RETURN p.name, t.name, r.valid_at, r.source_ids, r.gate_id, [n IN nodes(prov) | coalesce(n.name, n.id)], [x IN relationships(prov) | type(x)] ORDER BY e.id, g.ts
MATCH (q:Person)-[h:WAS]->(s:System {name: $system}) WHERE h.predicate = 'OWNS' OPTIONAL MATCH (q)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN q.name, t.name, h.invalid_at ORDER BY h.invalid_at DESC LIMIT 1

UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (g:GateDecision {id: i}) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:CITES]->(e:Episode) RETURN g.id, g.outcome, g.reasons, g.ts, g.predicate, g.subject, g.object, collect(DISTINCT e.id), g.claim_episode
UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (e:Episode {id: i}) RETURN e.id, e.title, e.ts, e.channel, e.author

answers.sentence: Luca Ostrander (Platform) owns billing-api, since 2026-09-22; before that Sana Petrov (Payments) until 2026-09-22. Sources: ADR-0009, msg-0148.
